description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 006 are pool accent mosaic tiles in blue and white, shown in the product photo as a feature area within a pool lined in blue, for anyone who wants one strong detail rather than a fully patterned pool.

## How they look
The photo shows a blue lining with a blue-and-white mosaic accent. The white pieces lift the design and make the accent stand out against the plain blue, while keeping to the same colour family so the pool still feels calm.

## Where they work
- **Pool tile accent bands** just below the coping or along one side wall.
- **Steps, benches and seating ledges**, where a lighter accent helps swimmers see the edge.
- **Feature panels** on the end wall of a pool seen from the house.

A small accent area is usually easier on the budget than patterning a whole pool and keeps the blue pool tile design simple to maintain.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: blue-and-white mosaic accent in a blue-lined pool (from the product photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; confirm them with your quote.

Mark out the accent area before tiling, keep the lines level with the waterline, and use a pool-grade grout. A white grout keeps the white pieces crisp but needs more regular brushing.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), then pair it with a plain lining such as [dark blue mosaic 002](/products/swimming-pool-tiles-002). Send your pool size for a dated quote, or see the full [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of pool accent mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Where should an accent mosaic go in a pool?
faqs.a: Common spots are a band below the coping, the edges of steps and benches, or the wall facing the house. Lighter accents on steps also help swimmers see where each step ends.

faqs.q: Is an accent band better than a full pattern?
faqs.a: For most home pools, yes. An accent gives a clear design detail at a smaller area, while a fully patterned pool can feel busy and costs more to lay.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
